info.title: Collara API
info.description: Synthetic demo data only. Errors are application/problem+json (RFC 9457).

get.summary: Sanitized infrastructure status
get.description: Always 200; `status` is `unavailable` when the database is down, `degraded` when storage, ledger or the projection worker is. In UI_MOCK without a database only the mode is reported.

get.summary: Start OIDC login (302 to the identity provider)
OIDC redirect target: exchanges the code, rotates the session, redirects into the app

post.summary: End the session (and return the provider's end-session URL for OIDC sessions)

get.summary: The signed-in user, active organization, roles, mandates and navigation
get.description: Derived server-side from the session; organization or party values sent by the browser are ignored.

get.summary: Seeded synthetic demo personas (demo environment only)

post.summary: Start an isolated demo session as a seeded persona (demo environment only)
Request a pilot conversation (public, rate-limited)
post.description: Stored before any notification. Email notification is not implemented yet, so the state stays RECEIVED. A non-empty honeypot field is discarded without storing.

get.summary: Command lifecycle status (submission, commit, projection)

post.summary: Authorize a private upload (new document or new version)

put.summary: Upload the file bytes into quarantine (raw body: application/pdf, image/jpeg or image/png; max 20 MB)

post.summary: Server-side SHA-256 and validation; promotes the bytes from quarantine to evidence storage

get.summary: Evidence document metadata
Short-lived (60 s) download link, issued after a server-side access check
Cases visible to the signed-in organisation

post.summary: Create a case for a registered asset (application record; no ledger transaction)

get.summary: Case detail (fields omitted by role and mandate)
Evidence documents of the case asset visible to the viewer

post.summary: Share the case package with the selected lender (owner), or consent to sharing own records (invited dealer)
Request verification of the case asset (owner); the verifier becomes a case participant

get.summary: Asset passports visible to the viewer

post.summary: Register an asset passport (owner request, registrar reservation and acceptance on the ledger)

get.summary: Asset passport detail
Evidence documents of the asset visible to the viewer

post.summary: Request verification of the asset (owner; may precede any case)

get.summary: Verification requests of the viewer (owner or assigned verifier)
Verification request detail
Attestation (owner, issuing verifier, or case participants with verification access)

post.summary: Accept or decline an assignment (assigned verifier)
Request changes to the evidence (assigned verifier)
Reject the verification (assigned verifier)
Issue the attestation (active assigned verifier); supersedes the verifier's previous attestation of the asset
Resubmit a new evidence version after a change request (owner); grants the selected documents at that version to the assigned verifier
Consent to the owner's verification grant requests for the dealer's own documents (invited dealer)

get.summary: Lender reviews visible to the caller
One lender review (fields omitted by role and mandate)

post.summary: Save the lender's collateral assessment (opens and starts the review when needed)
Submit the assessment for approval
Record the collateral decision (approver mandate)
Request information from the borrower

get.summary: Financing proposal (borrower and selected lender only)

post.summary: Issue a financing proposal (approver) or record a draft (analyst or approver; application record only)
Accept the exact proposal version (borrower)
Decline the exact proposal version (borrower)
Withdraw an issued proposal before acceptance (approver)
Authorize pledge activation for the accepted version (borrower)

get.summary: Pledges (collateral locks) visible to the caller
One pledge with its release requests

post.summary: Activate the pledge: consume the shared control and the borrower's authorization (lender approver)
Request release (the lock stays ACTIVE until the designated lender authorizes)

get.summary: One release request

post.summary: Authorize or reject a release request (designated lender approver only)
Ask the requester for information (designated lender approver only)
Answer the lender's information request (borrower)
Withdraw an open release request (requester)

get.summary: Package shares, verification scopes and audit grants visible to the viewer

post.summary: Grant an auditor scoped access to the caller's own records of a case (AuditGrant)

get.summary: Dealer consent requests: the invited dealer's own (to decide), or every dealer's for the owner

post.summary: Grant (Consent_Grant) or decline (Consent_Decline) a consent request for the dealer's own documents
Withdraw granted consent (Share_WithdrawConsent); limits future access only
Revoke a package share (owner) or an audit grant (its grantor); limits future access only

get.summary: Committed workflow events within the caller's scope (audit grants apply to auditors)

post.summary: Grant scoped audit access to an auditor (record owner: borrower or selected lender approver)
Revoke an audit grant (grantor only; limits future access)

get.summary: Case reports requested by the caller's organization

post.summary: Request a scoped case report (generated by the worker; application record, no ledger transaction)

get.summary: Short-lived (60 s) download link, issued after re-checking access
Verifier registry (governance-administered); open proposals only for governance seats
Tier A governance: threshold, seats, registry version, integration status
Governed verifier proposals (newest first)

post.summary: Propose Add / Suspend verifier (seat), pinned to the live registry; the proposer's confirmation is included

get.summary: One governed proposal with live confirmations

post.summary: Confirm a proposal as your governance seat (GovernanceRules_ConfirmAction)
Execute with the live confirmations of distinct seats (GovernanceRules_ExecuteConfirmedAction)
Withdraw your own open proposal (GovernableAction_ProposerCancel)

get.summary: Onboarded lender organizations (id and display name only)
Onboarded dealer organizations (id and display name only)
Recorded financing principal and collateral valuation per currency, for the signed-in organisation's own scope
